quote: The Director of Public Works is authorized to erect signs on any other sidewalk or any roadway in the City prohibiting the riding of bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters thereon by any person when the Director after consultation with the City Traffic Engineer and the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department determines that the use of bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters on the sidewalk or roadway in question will impede or interfere with the flow of pedestrian or vehicular traffic, and when such signs are in place it shall be unlawful for any person to disobey the same.

activation.description: A reviewed prohibition sign is physically in place on the roadway and governs the covered rider.

obligation.description: Do not disobey the physically erected applicable prohibition sign by riding in its governed roadway interval.

timing.description: At each instant of actual riding within the sign-governed interval.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: impede or interfere with the flow of pedestrian or vehicular traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Director determination and consultation require source review; no numerical cutoff is supplied.

parameter_refs.name: signed_roadway_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed sign, roadway and Director sources
